concerns.text: Phase 7 (T041-T053) is appended AFTER Phase 6 (Polish) and after the 'Checkpoint' for US3. However, T041 (streaming), T042 (column mapping), and T043 (Ev filtering) are foundational data ingestion/preprocessing steps that MUST precede T012 (Download) and T014 (Preprocessing). Placing them after model training (US2) and explainability (US3) creates a fatal ordering violation where the pipeline attempts to train models on data that hasn't been validated or filtered yet.

T045 (Material Mismatch check) is placed in Phase 7, but T012b (Verified Accuracy Gate) explicitly states this check must happen 'BEFORE any download'. T045 attempts to implement a secondary check logic that contradicts the 'static list' constraint of T012b and is ordered too late in the pipeline to prevent the download of invalid data.

T046 (CPU performance guardrail) is placed in Phase 7, but it modifies the training logic of T022/T023 (US2). Since US2 is already marked 'complete' in Phase 4, T046 cannot retroactively alter the training execution order or hyperparameters without re-running US2. This breaks the 'Producer before Consumer' flow for the model artifacts.

Phase 7 is labeled 'Execution Robustness & Real Data Verification' but contains tasks (T041, T042, T043) that are logically prerequisites for Phase 3 (Data Acquisition). The phase label implies post-hoc checks, but the content requires pre-hoc implementation. This semantic mismatch obscures the true dependency graph.
